title: software-factory implement output
description: What the implement stage returns: its report as markdown, whether it finished, and the pull request title/body for the branch as it now stands.

report.description: The implementation report, as markdown. Its first line is one sentence summarising the outcome.

blocked.description: True if the stage did not complete the work: blocked, or the plan turned out unimplementable.

blocked_reason.description: Why, when blocked is true. Empty string when blocked is false.

title.description: The pull request title for the branch as it now stands. Empty when blocked is true and nothing was pushed worth describing.

body.description: The pull request body for the branch as it now stands, using the repository's pull request template. Empty when blocked is true and nothing was pushed worth describing.
